prompt: Photorealistic editorial still life for Italian tailor Cotton Leaf (no written branding), landscape 4:3. An open physical shirting sample book on a pale warm cream stone worktable in a Roman tailoring shop. The binder lays open flat with a central spine. Both pages are covered with many real, individual pinked-edge cotton shirting fabric swatches attached by a single edge so their layered loose corners can be picked up and touched. At least 16 distinct samples: sober pale and mid blues, shades of warm white, pale lavender, sage, gray, precise fine pinstripes, small ginghams and subtle twills, realistic cloth fibers and drape. A few swatches are naturally curled up at their edge so they read as actual fabrics rather than printed illustrations. The open book fills most of frame with comfortable margins, top-down at a very slight oblique angle, a few natural shadows, natural afternoon window light. No hands, people, captions, prominent labels, text, lettering or logos. Modern restrained sartorial photography, tactile and inviting.
